entries.name: IOUserBluetoothSerialDriver
entries.note: Serial over Bluetooth (RFCOMM) comes from the Linux rfcomm kernel module. bluetooth.rs drives the radio through the kernel management socket and does not open RFCOMM serial ports for apps.
entries.ready_note: The rfcomm kernel module provides the Bluetooth serial ports. bluetooth.rs is tested; it does not open RFCOMM ports for apps, so the app-facing side stays out of scope.
